title: Relabelled placement
statement: For natural numbers $k,l$, let a placement map the $k$ positions injectively into the $l$ positions, with its exact selector. Relabel the $k$ positions by a bijection from the $k$ positions to themselves; the resulting placement sends each position through that bijection and then through the original placement, and its selector applies the inverse bijection to the original selector's value when that value exists.
hypotheses_covered: A placement from $k$ positions into $l$ positions
